timestamp_rule: Capture one RFC3339 UTC Z timestamp before generation; inject it unchanged into both runs and compare raw hashes.

artifacts.rendering: validated Case A JSON; headings # M15B Phase 4 Case A Evidence Comparison, ## Scope and frozen inputs, ## Findings, ## Triage, Decision Board, and engineering-memory effects, ## Uncertainty and recommendations, ## Disclosure statement; table fields in schema order; finding ID ascending; escape pipe/backslash/CR/LF; empty=—; no appendix/timestamp/free text; final LF
execution manifest pre_commit_gates in schema order plus fixed stops, independence boundary, and external commit/push statement; exact headings in handoff; escaped cells; empty=—; final LF

artifact_addition_policy: No artifact may be added, omitted, or renamed without an independently accepted pre-reveal amendment.
semantic_validator_requirements: exact comparison/leakage inventory extraction, counts, digests, uniqueness and ordering
Case A material requires non-no_change downstream effect
no numeric score unless separately frozen
Case B contract path/hash and prohibited-field audit

test_accounting.frozen_parent_comparison: same run count, exact skip names and reasons; zero failed/errored; any difference blocks
